name: Caerulescent-Tempest
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past an ancient meteor crater, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Debris from the starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
